card.name: Body-state terms in lab and symptom warnings
card.fires_on: Fires on a spot right before or inside a word for a body condition or lab finding, such as electrolyte, hypocalcemia, hypotension, fever, or the list nausea, vomiting, diarrhea. It is mostly partway through words or on a comma or number step in warnings.

modes.description: Partway through words like electrolyte, hypercalcemia or hypotension.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words about the body and illness, such as body and fever, in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It lights up in warnings about body conditions and lab values, like fluid loss, low calcium or fever.
